en: The Pair of States Accompanied by Equanimity, and the Triplet of Wholesome States.
Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by equanimity, a state that is neither accompanied by equanimity nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by equanimity, a state that is neither accompanied by equanimity nor wholesome arises by way of root condition. Dependent on both a wholesome state accompanied by equanimity and a wholesome state not accompanied by equanimity...

Dependent on a state accompanied by equanimity, an unwholesome state not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on an unwholesome state accompanied by equanimity, a state not accompanied by equanimity and not unwholesome arises by way of root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state not accompanied by equanimity, a state not accompanied by equanimity and not unwholesome...

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on unwholesome states accompanied by equanimity and unwholesome states not accompanied by equanimity, a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-unaccompanied-by-equanimity arises by way of root condition.
There are three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
